title: Games: play together in calls and chats
summary: A new Games hub with twelve free multiplayer games and a daily word puzzle. Start one from a call with Play Together and keep talking while you play.

new: Games hub (gamepad icon in the sidebar, or You → Games on phones): Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect Four, Rock Paper Scissors, Chess, Checkers, Battleship, Memory Match, Word Race, Hangman, Word Duel, Trivia Battle and Sketch & Guess
Play Together in voice and video calls: pick a game, everyone in the call is invited, and the game shows next to the cameras while the call keeps going
Invite friends from the hub or from a conversation; private lobbies only the people you invite can join
Daily Word: one five-letter word a day, the same for everyone, with streaks and a spoiler-free result to share
Rematches, switching games, series scores, and minimizing a game to come back to it later
Game statistics on your profile (wins, losses, draws, favourite game, recent matches), which you can hide
Game sounds with their own volume and mute; Do Not Disturb silences game invitations
improved: The server checks every move, so nobody can see hidden cards, ships or answers early or change a result

title: Profiles look the way their owners made them
summary: Your profile background, name colours and decorations now look the same to everyone, whatever app theme they use, and uploaded backgrounds show clearly. Profile customization works on phones too.

new: Background darkness slider in Settings → Profile: from 0% (your picture exactly as uploaded) to 100%
improved: The glass panel behind profile text can now be switched off when you use a background
fixed: App themes no longer tint or cover other people's profile backgrounds, name colours, nameplates or decorations
Uploaded profile backgrounds were barely visible behind a dark layer; they now show clearly
On phones, Profile and Customize Profile open again, including from Settings and the You tab

title: Custom ringtones, sharper calls and quieter microphones
summary: Choose and upload your own call sounds, share a ringtone with friends, pick how much background noise to remove, and set yourself Away or Do Not Disturb in one click. Free for everyone.

new: Call sounds in Settings → Notifications: pick a built-in ringtone, upload your own (MP3, WAV or OGG), or go silent, separately for incoming and outgoing calls
Shared ringtones: choose a ringtone friends can hear while they call you, and choose whether you hear yours, theirs or nothing when you call
Per-friend sounds: a special ringtone when a particular friend calls
Change your username once every 30 days in Settings → Account; friends, messages and mentions stay connected
Status menu: click your name in the bottom-left corner to switch between Online, Away and Do Not Disturb
Automatic Away after a period of inactivity you choose, only when none of your devices is in use
Noise suppression levels (Off, Low, Medium, High) with a microphone test so you can hear the difference
improved: High noise suppression adds a rumble filter and a speech gate that turns down typing and clicks between words
Change noise suppression during a call from the microphone menu
Reset a participant's volume to default with one click; volume changes only affect what you hear
fixed: Camera video no longer goes soft, shifts or changes colour when you move the mouse over a call
The camera preview no longer turns transparent when you scroll through the camera effects
security: Uploaded ringtones are re-encoded on the server and stay private unless you choose to share one

title: Themes: make Emix look completely yours
summary: Twelve built-in themes, a theme editor anyone can use, and sharing with friends and the community. Free for everyone.

new: 12 built-in themes, from Emix Default, Midnight and AMOLED Black to Neon Nights, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Emerald, Crimson, Sunset, Lavender, Arctic and Pastel
Theme editor in Settings → Appearance: build a full palette from three colours, then fine-tune every colour with a live preview
Gradient and image backgrounds, frosted-glass transparency, corner style, font choice and accent glow
Share themes in direct messages and channels: friends get a preview card and choose whether to apply it
Community gallery with search, categories, likes and most popular or recent themes
Import and export themes as files, save shared themes to your collection with the creator credited
Your theme is saved to your account and follows you to every device
improved: Camera effects look the same in the preview and in calls, and keep working when you switch tabs
Separate options for mirroring your self-view and mirroring what others see
fixed: Your own camera tile no longer goes blank when you turn the camera on with an effect enabled
The camera preview works after you leave a call
security: Themes are validated data only: they can't run code, inject styles or hide warnings, and text is kept readable

title: Make your profile yours, and take control of your camera and mic
summary: Free profile customization for everyone, a camera preview before you go live, and device switching without leaving a call.

new: Profile customization, free for everyone: name colours, gradients, rainbow, neon and shimmer effects
Nameplates behind your name in member lists, friends, direct messages and voice channels
Avatar decorations: neon rings, flames, hearts, stars, snowflakes, holographic frames and more
Profile backgrounds: preset themes, custom gradients or your own image, with position, zoom, opacity, blur and a glass card
Profile effects that play when someone opens your profile, from falling stars to digital rain
Pronouns and up to five links on your profile, plus saved looks you can switch between
A new Profile editor in Settings with a live preview
Camera preview before you turn your camera on or start a video call
Camera and microphone menus on the call bar: switch camera, microphone or speakers without leaving the call
Camera effects processed on your device: brightness, contrast, saturation, colour filters, soft focus and zoom
What's New: release notes in the app and at getemix.com/changelog
improved: Larger, higher-resolution profile banners with adjustable framing
Animated GIF avatars and banners now keep their animation
Microphone level meter in the device menu, so you can check your input before you speak

title: Welcome to Emix
summary: The first Emix release: private messaging, voice and video calls, and screen sharing.

new: The new Emix design, with dark surfaces and pink, purple and blue accents
Video quality settings: 720p to 4K at 30 or 60 fps, with a bitrate choice
The Emix desktop app for Windows, with automatic updates
security: Usage statistics and telemetry are removed: Emix sends no analytics anywhere
